You deliver #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, by sharing specialized knowledge in culinary techniques, cooking fundamentals, and personalized instruction that supports all company initiatives. The Chef Instructor, Savory plays a key role in inspiring a love for cooking while driving sales of cookware, cutlery, and kitchen tools through hands-on savory classes and engaging culinary instruction. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail culinary product sales, and guest feedback through Google reviews. Team Engagement & Store Support · Assist in setting up and breakdown of classes including organizing mise en place, prepping ingredients, and cleaning workstations. · Clean and sanitize dishes and equipment promptly to ensure smooth kitchen operations. · Assist with restocking, organizing, and maintaining kitchen supplies and tools to support overall store readiness. Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs). cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:7e1.title: Vice President, Performance Marketing
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:7e1.description: Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. At Backcountry, we are rooted in adventure, recognition, and wellbeing on and off the mountain. We spotlight employee stories, celebrate milestones, and offer exclusive outdoor perks. Whether you are at HQ, in a retail store, or remote, you will be part of a team that thrives on energy, exploration, and connection. Reports to: Senior Vice President, Marketing Location: Salt Lake City, Utah (Hybrid - 3x/week in-office)
responsibilities: Performance Marketing Strategy
Own the performance marketing P&L and multi-year strategy across all four Backcountry banners, spanning paid search, paid social, shopping/feed, display, affiliate, video/TV, and emerging channels.
Set channel and budget allocation based on incrementality, LTV, and blended CAC targets, and defend those trade-offs to the executive team.
Translate company revenue and margin targets into a multi-year paid media investment plan.
Build repeatable playbooks for launches, promotions, and seasonal peaks that scale across the brand portfolio.
Champion a continuous A/B and multivariate testing culture across creative, landing pages, and audience targeting, turning results into scaled learnings.
Track competitor activity and market trends across the outdoor and active lifestyle space to identify new channels, formats, and positioning opportunities.
Team Leadership and Organization
Build and lead a team of performance marketing leaders and specialists, including a Senior Director of Performance Marketing, plus supporting agencies.
Set operating standards for testing velocity, reporting rigor, and channel expertise, and hold your leadership team accountable to them.
Stay close enough to the numbers and the work to catch problems early, coach through them, and step in directly when needed.
Hold agency partners accountable to performance benchmarks, media efficiency, and clear scopes of work.
Own new channel expansion with hands-on execution of campaigns in emerging channels.
Drive adoption and demonstrated use of AI and automation tools across the team to improve decisions, increase output, and free up time for high-value work.
Executive and Cross-Functional Leadership
Sit on Backcountry's marketing leadership team and represent performance marketing in company-level strategy and planning.
Partner with Creative to ensure ad concepts and assets are built for performance from the start.
Partner with Merchandising to align paid spend with inventory, margin, and assortment priorities.
Partner with eCommerce, Product, and Web Development to ensure landing pages, site experience, and conversion funnels support paid traffic quality.
Report to the executive team on channel performance, budget efficiency, and growth opportunities, translating performance data into clear commercial recommendations.
Flag risks and opportunities early, and bring solutions rather than just problems.
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
12+ years of experience in performance marketing or paid media, including 5+ years leading managers or team leads, not just individual contributors.
Proven ownership of a paid media budget spanning multiple channels (search, social, shopping/feed, display) at a scale consistent with a multi-brand or multi-hundred-million-dollar revenue business.
Track record of owning performance marketing across multiple brands or business units simultaneously.
Strong command of performance marketing economics: CAC, LTV, incrementality, marginal ROAS, and blended efficiency.
Demonstrated ability to influence and align Creative, Merchandising, eCommerce, and executive stakeholders without direct authority over their teams.
Proven experience building and leading teams of leaders, and managing agency relationships at scale.
Strong executive presence and communication skills, with experience reporting directly to the C-suite or serving on a leadership team.
Demonstrated experience using AI and automation tools to improve decisions, increase output, or improve team efficiency.
Hands-on fluency with major ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager) and analytics/reporting tools (Google Analytics, Tableau or Looker Studio), even if day-to-day execution sits with the team.
Experience in outdoor, sporting goods, cycling, or active lifestyle ecommerce.
Experience with multi-brand or multi-site paid media management (shared team supporting several storefronts).

Our partner is looking for a Staff Software Engineer, GitHub Intelligence (Copilot Agents) based in United States. This is a staff-level engineering role focused on advancing the infrastructure that enables AI agents to understand and use software-development context effectively. You will help build intelligent context capabilities spanning agent memory, search, knowledge graphs, retrieval, and connected developer tools. Your work will influence how AI agents reason across code, issues, pull requests, workflows, and other development signals. Foster an inclusive, collaborative environment where engineers have clear ownership and are empowered to deliver high-quality work. Equivalent experience may include an associate degree with 8+ years of relevant experience, a bachelor’s degree with 7+ years, a master’s degree with 5+ years, or a doctorate with 3+ years of relevant experience. Strong production programming experience in one or more languages such as C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, Python, or TypeScript. Experience with information retrieval, context retrieval, knowledge graphs, semantic systems, personalization, persistent knowledge, or memory systems is highly valuable. Experience designing or integrating production AI-agent or generative-AI capabilities, including model orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, tool use, evaluation, or feedback loops. You’ll work at the intersection of creative design and technical execution, partnering closely with developers and creative teams. The role offers ownership from early concepts and user flows through high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes. You’ll bring strong visual design fundamentals while considering usability, responsiveness, accessibility, and how products are actually built. AI-powered design tools will be part of the workflow, helping you explore ideas and prototype quickly without compromising quality. You’ll have the opportunity to work on conventional and experimental digital experiences, with room to contribute creative ideas and new approaches. This is a fully remote position requiring strong communication, autonomy, attention to detail, and availability during AEST working hours. Design intuitive, high-quality user interfaces and experiences for web and mobile products, balancing usability, aesthetics, and technical feasibility. Translate briefs, business objectives, and product requirements into user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and polished digital experiences. Develop interactive prototypes in Figma that effectively communicate user behaviour, interactions, transitions, and overall product experience. Establish and maintain strong visual design systems, applying disciplined grids, spacing, typography, hierarchy, and responsive layouts. Use AI-powered design and creative tools to accelerate ideation, exploration, and rapid prototyping while maintaining a high standard of design quality. Collaborate closely with developers and technical teams throughout the design process to ensure accurate and practical implementation. Present design concepts and decisions clearly to colleagues, clients, and stakeholders, incorporating feedback while confidently explaining design rationale. Take ownership of projects from initial concept through final delivery, identifying problems and developing thoughtful, creative solutions. Help structure and organise design work, documentation, and workflows so projects progress efficiently across distributed teams. Contribute to experimental and innovative digital experiences, including immersive websites, animations, micro-interactions, and other emerging design approaches where relevant. Requirements: 5+ years of professional experience in UI/UX Design, Product Design, Digital Design, or a comparable senior design position. A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent UI/UX capabilities, visual design quality, and creative range, particularly across web experiences. Advanced proficiency in Figma, including interactive prototyping and the ability to communicate complex interactions effectively. Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, usability, information architecture and hierarchy, responsive design, and accessibility fundamentals. Excellent visual design skills, with a deliberate and consistent approach to grids, spacing, typography, composition, and layout. Proven experience collaborating closely with developers or other technical teams and understanding the practical considerations involved in implementation. Ability to take an idea from an initial concept or rough brief through user flows, design exploration, prototyping, and a polished final experience. Strong creative problem-solving skills, curiosity, and the ability to challenge conventional approaches when appropriate. Excellent written and verbal English, with confidence presenting designs and articulating the reasoning behind design decisions. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate effectively within a fully remote environment. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is a plus,

southparkcommons-rox-ai:ashbyhq:b1e8aba6.description: ABOUT ROX Rox is building the AI-native revenue operating system for modern go-to-market teams. Backed by Sequoia, GV, and General Catalyst, we’re working with some of the most ambitious enterprise teams to replace fragmented CRM workflows with intelligent, autonomous systems. Rox connects data across the GTM stack, deploys AI agents to do real work, and gives revenue leaders a clear, shared picture of what actually drives outcomes. We’re a small, fast-moving Series A team taking on one of software’s most entrenched categories — and we’re winning by combining deep technical rigor with obsessive focus on usefulness. ABOUT THE SOLUTIONS ENGINEERING TEAM Solutions Engineering at Rox is not a support role — it’s a product-shaping, deal-defining function. This team sits at the center of Sales, Product, and Engineering, and is responsible for turning Rox’s technical capabilities into undeniable customer value. You’ll be joining at the ground floor of the SF SE team. Reporting directly to our Solutions Engineering leader, and you’ll work alongside three in-seat SEs in San Francisco while helping establish how this function scales in SF. The patterns you set — how we demo, how we scope, how we integrate, how we sell — will become the blueprint for the company. ABOUT THE ROLE This is a Solutions Engineer role for someone who is equal parts technical, customer-obsessed, and opinionated about how great sales engineering should work. You’ll spend your time embedded in real deals: running technical discovery, designing integrations, and leading demos that show customers exactly how Rox fits into their data and GTM environment. But this role goes beyond execution. You’ll identify what’s broken or inefficient in the sales process and fix it — improving demo flows, tightening technical narratives, and raising the bar for everyone who comes after you. If you enjoy being the person in the room who can both go deep technically and translate complexity into clarity, this role will feel like home. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Become a product expert quickly, with a deep understanding of Rox’s architecture, use cases, and customer workflows - Partner closely with Sales to run high-impact technical demos and support deals from first call through close - Design and explain integrations across data warehouses, CRMs, AI agents, and modern GTM tooling - Lead technical discovery conversations that surface real customer problems — not just stated requirements - Translate customer feedback into clear, actionable insights for Product and Engineering - Improve how Rox sells by refining demo narratives, technical positioning, and sales enablement - Help onboard and train new Solutions Engineers as the team scales across the East Coast WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - In your first few days: You understand Rox’s product well enough to speak confidently about the platform and its value - Within a few weeks: You’re running live demos and actively contributing to deals in the pipeline - Within a few months: You’re raising the bar — improving the sales motion, mentoring new SEs, and shaping how Solutions Engineering operates at Rox MUST-HAVE SKILLS - Experience as a Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, or similar technical customer-facing role in B2B SaaS - Strong understanding of modern data ecosystems, including data warehouses and GTM stacks - Hands-on experience with integrations involving CRMs, analytics tools, or AI-driven systems - Ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences - Comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where process is still being built - A track record of partnering effectively with Sales and Product teams to drive outcomes WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS Rox is scaling quickly, and the way we sell matters as much as what we build. weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:f87e1b41-677.description: About Adapt Adapt, a Welo Global brand, is an international digital performance marketing agency focused on driving the success of digital content across platforms and markets. We offer our customers a unique combination of global services designed to support their growth from strategy all the way through to execution, production, and performance measurement. With a collaborative and inclusive environment, you will join a unique culture which celebrates difference and embraces diversity. You will play a key role in developing strong relationships and shared ethos, whilst at the same time benefiting from a wide range of career opportunities, training, and flexibility for work-life balance. Our culture is built on curiosity, and we are looking for team members who have a passion for learning about the developments in the industry, their clients, and their peers. In return, we offer the opportunity to develop your ability and exposure to a wide range of clients from growth-minded startups all the way up to global enterprise clients. Our client base is predominantly focused on B2B businesses, though we do also support customers in the e-commerce and retail space. Regardless of vertical, Adapt offers dynamic and diverse challenges that foster creativity, innovation and application of knowledge to create client solutions. Job Reference: #LI-JC1 Overview At Welo, an SEO Account Specialist leads strategic SEO initiatives across a diverse portfolio of global clients. You’ll leverage technical expertise and a data-driven mindset to develop, execute, and optimise comprehensive SEO strategies that drive measurable business outcomes.
qualifications: Ability to conduct comprehensive SEO audits and competitive analysis.
